settings.heading: Talk to us
settings.text: Sizing, exchanges, order status — we reply within one working day.

settings.question: Where is my order?
settings.answer: Every order ships with a tracking link. If it has been more than 7 days, write to us with your order number and we will chase it.

settings.question: How do I exchange a size?
settings.answer: Reply to your order confirmation with the size you need. One exchange per order is free within 7 days.
